q: The Fubini-Tonelli theorem allows switching the order of integration. Tonelli's version (for non-negative functions) requires:
opts: Both measures to be σ-finite (and the function to be non-negative measurable)
The product space to be compact
exp: Tonelli's theorem: for σ-finite measures and a non-negative measurable f, ∫∫ f d(μ×ν) = ∫(∫f dμ) dν = ∫(∫f dν) dμ with all integrals equal (possibly infinite). Fubini then extends this to integrable functions.
